candidates.A: mean six-torque squared residual on teacher states
candidates.B: fixed five-control causal box residual, valid controls only
candidates.C: development affine explained MSE plus twice residual MSE
candidates.D: same-start synchronized motion with explicit missing fraction
candidates.E: development-standardized joint occupancy SW2 plus explicit missing fraction

rejected_candidates.conditional_mean_lambda1: With the true conditional mean, orthogonal decomposition equals expected MSE

contradictory_observation_components.explanation: Residual includes misspecification and support shift; it is not identified noise.

nonlinear_exact_copy_C.explanation: Residual includes misspecification and support shift; it is not identified noise.

calibrations.C_identity_limitation: C is a model-dependent proxy, not an identity metric; exact nonlinear copies can have positive explanatory residual.
calibrations.scope: Synthetic array/controller arithmetic only; no Walker execution or fresh-student learning competence claim

process_lifetime_usage.scope: Child process lifetime, including imports. Final receipt write follows. Nested wall and CPU times are not additive.
